name: Fables PoolRegistry

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: A hook-native ve(3,3) DEX on Uniswap v4. A full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay from genesis finds exactly one ADMIN_ROLE holder, ever - an EIP-7702-delegated EOA with 470 real transactions, not a multisig.
narrative.detail: EIP-7702 delegation gives the address code (a smart-account implementation), but does not itself imply multi-party signing - no owners/threshold interface resolves at this address. Scored as a real, active bare-EOA equivalent: sole control, no delay on register/deregister/setAuthority.
